angles.name: The Calm One at the Gate
angles.hook: Close-up of a red departure board flipping to cancelled as a traveler's face reflects in the glass; a collective groan is implied by a few blurred figures slumping behind her.
angles.concept: While blurred travelers behind her pace and rub their temples, our traveler glances at her phone, exhales, smiles, and calmly walks off to a sleek airport lounge with coffee in hand. Contrast does the work: same disruption, completely different day.
angles.cta: Be the calm one. Get NomadGuard.

angles.name: The Wallet Wince
angles.hook: Extreme close-up of a traveler's hand hesitating over a hotel desk bell at midnight, suitcase beside him, his face tight with dread at the cost of an unplanned night.
angles.concept: He winces as he slides his card across the counter, then his phone buzzes; he reads it, his shoulders drop, and he grins and collapses onto a crisp hotel bed. Edit overlays carry the 'covered' message so the model never renders numbers or UI.
angles.cta: Delays happen. Paying for them doesn't have to. Try NomadGuard.

angles.name: Turn the Delay Into a Day Off
angles.hook: A traveler sprinting through a terminal stops dead, looks up at an off-screen board, and freezes with a split-second 'oh no' face.
angles.concept: Smash cut: same traveler, now unbothered, sipping a spritz on a sunlit terrace overlooking the city she was only meant to pass through. Protection reframes disruption as a bonus adventure.

selection.why_selected: The side-by-side contrast between the stressed blurred background and the calm hero tells the whole value proposition in one frame, with sound off and no reliance on text or UI. It needs one traveler, one or two locations, and simple actions: look, exhale, smile, walk.
selection.audience_insight: Frequent 25-40 travelers have all been the panicked person at the gate, and they badly want to be the composed, in-control one; the ad sells that identity, not a policy.
selection.why_it_works_on_social: The cancellation moment is instantly recognizable and stops the scroll, and the 'everyone panics but her' contrast is a native, meme-able format that drives saves and shares. The premium lounge payoff delivers the polished, confident brand feel in a few seconds.
